name: Halhaven
description: Halhaven burns at the edge of charted space, its light reaching survey scopes long before any hull. Tidal kneading keeps the inner planets restless, and quake swarms punctuate the long quiet. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

stars.name: Ashen Thorn
stars.description: A K-class star burning orange, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Shielding ratings for the inner worlds are set by its worst recorded outburst.

planets.name: Rustwold
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. Water exists only as deep brine the drills have yet to reach. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

moons.name: Bitter Rubble III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: Broadmark
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Bioluminescent tides mark the shallows where the water runs warm. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

planets.name: Umberhollow
planets.description: Methane haze wraps a slushy mantle, cold and blue and utterly calm. Faint rings tilt at an angle that bothers the mathematicians. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

planets.name: The Quartz holm
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Its ring shepherds keep the lanes clear and the rumors plentiful. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

dwarfPlanets.name: Gilded Minor 5
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.name: Pebble 856
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.
